drawings.description: croquis en marge, à hauteur de la définition de $Z_2$ :
drawings.kind: margin square X x T <- X x T x T', T <- T x T'
drawings.notes: X x T <- X x T x T' above, T <- T x T' below, joined by plain vertical strokes, as in the tikzcd of the transcription.

drawings.kind: margin diagram X - Y, X x T -> Y x T over T
drawings.notes: X - Y (the stroke shows no head), X x T -> Y x T (the arrow has a mark at its tail), a vertical arrow from X x T down and a diagonal arrow from Y x T down to T; both arrows are drawn ending as on the page. Omitted as struck: the overwritten letter left of T, under the vertical arrow. Issue 128, 2026-11-09: struck material left out after a fresh check of the facsimile (struck-out material is not drawn). Redrawn 2026-11-09 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à droite, un croquis : trois cônes emboîtés de même sommet, figurés par trois ovales emboîtés, tangents entre eux à droite, marqués $P$, $Q$, $R$ de l'extérieur vers l'intérieur, et par des génératrices issues du sommet commun, en bas ; la génératrice de droite, commune aux trois, est épaissie.
drawings.kind: three nested cones with a common vertex, marked P, Q, R
drawings.notes: As on the page: three nested ovals (the sections of the cones), the larger containing the smaller, all three touching at the right near the heavy generator; the letters P (on the outer one, at the top), Q (on the middle one) and R (inside the inner one); four generators from the common vertex, drawn from that one point: to the left end of the outer oval, to the left end of the middle oval, to the left end of the inner oval, and the heavy one at the right, tangent to the three ovals. Ovals are drawn as ellipses fitted to his outlines. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: au milieu de la page, deux croquis : à gauche un arc de courbe épais, montant vers la droite ; à droite un quadrilatère aux côtés légèrement courbes, penché vers la droite (un morceau de surface).
drawings.kind: an arc of curve and a patch of surface
drawings.notes: As on the page: a heavy arc rising from the lower left to the upper right, and at its right a slanted quadrilateral with slightly curved sides (two long sides leaning to the right, a short top and a short curved bottom), its left side heavy. No label. The frame of the boxed formula that enters the crop at the upper left is left out. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: en bas à gauche, un croquis de cône : un ovale (la section), deux génératrices issues du sommet, en bas à gauche, et un gros point marqué à l'intérieur du cône, relié au sommet ; à droite l'étiquette « $P_{2}^{+}$ ».
drawings.kind: cone with a marked interior point, labelled P_2^+
drawings.notes: As on the page: the oval section, the two generators from the vertex to its left and right ends, the heavy point inside the cone with the stroke that joins it to the vertex, and the label at the right. The label is read P_2^+ after the note of the transcription; on the page the index is small and could be an i; the line above the sketch has P_2^+ (« A_2 contains P_2^+ »), which supports the reading 2. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.

drawings.description: à gauche de la page (feuillet écrit dans le sens de la hauteur), des croquis au crayon : quatre courts segments portant chacun un point marqué en leur milieu ; plus bas, deux droites épaisses qui se croisent, et à leur gauche trois petits traits.
drawings.kind: four short segments each with a marked point; two crossing lines
drawings.notes: As on the page, in the orientation of the scan (the pencil notes of this sheet are written along its height): four short segments, each with a marked point on it (computed on the segment), and below them two heavy lines crossing at one point (one of them drawn double on the page: drawn once), with three short strokes at their left (a vertical one and two small oblique ones). The sketches stand beside the rings k[t] with t^2, t^3 and k[x,y]/xy: a point on a branch, and the node. Redrawn 2026-11-12 (issue 128): to check again.
drawings.orientation: sheet written along its height; redrawn in the orientation of the scan
